mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_ledger WHERE business_no=#{businessNo} AND entry_type='PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED'
SELECT * FROM payment_order WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order(payment_no,order_no,user_id,amount_cents,currency) VALUES(#{paymentNo},#{orderNo},#{userId},#{amountCents},#{currency}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_no=payment_no
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status=IF(channel_version=0,'UNKNOWN',status),last_error='通道结果未知，恢复任务先查询原支付号',version=version+1 WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND review_required='NO' AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CLOSED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_request(actor_type,actor_id,operation,idempotency_key,request_hash,business_no,state) VALUES('USER',#{actorId},'SUBMIT_PAYMENT',#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{businessNo},'SUCCEEDED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM idempotency_request WHERE actor_type='USER' AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation='SUBMIT_PAYMENT' AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO process_task(task_no,task_type,business_no,step,payload,next_retry_at) VALUES(#{taskNo},'PAYMENT',#{taskNo},'SUBMIT',JSON_OBJECT(),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM process_task WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE process_task SET step=IF(state='RUNNING' OR step='QUERY','QUERY','CLOSE'),state='READY',next_retry_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),lease_until=NULL,claim_version=claim_version+1,version=version+1 WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} AND state!='MANUAL_REVIEW'
UPDATE process_task SET step='QUERY',version=version+1 WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} AND step IN ('SUBMIT','CLOSE')
mapper.select: SELECT task_no FROM process_task WHERE task_type='PAYMENT' AND ((state='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM channel_notification WHERE notification_no=#{notificationNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_type='PAYMENT' AND ((status='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
